dense.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
dense.query_input: query_prefix + query_text (identity fields are already part of query_text)
dense.tie_break: same rule as bm25.tie_break (SHA256(seed | query_id | evidence_id)), same seed

hybrid.formula: RRF(d) = sum over methods m with d in top-100_m of 1 / (rrf_k + rank_m(d)); missing list => no contribution
hybrid.tie_break: same SHA256 rule as bm25.tie_break; never CURRENT/OUTDATED, time or replacement order

bm25_tie_break.note: evidence_id carries the chain sequence number, so plain evidence_id order would leak interval order

oracle.note: upper bounds over the BM25 top-k candidates; not model results
